findings.title: amountDue ignored discount_amount
findings.oracle_violation: Coupon-prepaid orders still showed residual due; delivery could demand COD / stay in delivered instead of delivered_and_paid
evidence: OrderMoneyFlow.computeBreakdown already used food+charges-discount as billNet
Checkout set payment_status with max(0, lineTotal - lineDiscount)
findings.fix: Order::netTotalAmount() + amountDue uses net; residual settlement sets amount_paid = netTotalAmount()

findings.title: Cancel duplicated without row lock
findings.oracle_violation: Web DeleteOrderModal and API cancelOrder duplicated refund/cancel; no lockForUpdate unlike package skip
findings.fix: App\Support\OrderCancellation::cancelPendingOwnedBy — shared by web + API, locks order, refunds amount_paid only

findings.title: Residual settlement wrote amount_paid = total_amount
findings.oracle_violation: Cash/gateway settle could inflate amount_paid above economic net when discount_amount > 0

findings.title: Multi-date without forced prepay always COD
findings.fix: OrderPaymentMethod::checkoutOptions/resolveCheckout/checkoutChargeAmount now drive both web and API. Multi-date carts without forced prepay intentionally resolve to cash_on_delivery.

findings.title: Package skip/cancel refund used amount_paid ?: total_amount
findings.oracle_violation: Discounted prepaid packages could refund gross scheduled day amounts instead of allocated economic prepaid value.
findings.fix: App\Support\PackageRefund is the refund oracle for subscription net totals and per-day allocations; PackageSubscriptionService, corporate package UI, and mobile API use the service-returned refund.

findings.title: Hot order status transitions were ad hoc strings
findings.fix: App\Support\OrderTransition encodes the current pending→processing/packed/cancelled, packed→on_the_way_to_delivery, on_the_way_to_delivery→delivered(_and_paid), and delivered→delivered_and_paid paths used by kitchen, delivery, cancellation, and settlement.

findings.title: Permission model exists but role gates dominate
findings.notes: No quick safe pivot found. Current flows consistently gate by role names; moving to permission-backed policies would be a larger auth design/migration.

out_of_scope_this_pass: Full formal order status Enum / state machine
